arStrings.szText: A {c_important}Shade{/c} {c_important}Dashes{/c} after you, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_IMPACT}{/c} damage. {c_important}Dash's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_38}{/c} second per enemy you hit, up to {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Dash{/c} is also a {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skill. At the end of {c_important}Dash{/c}, explode and Knock Down surrounding enemies for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds, dealing {c_number}{payload:MOD_B_IMPACT}{/c} damage to them.

At the end of {c_important}Dash{/c}, you enter {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_36]{/c} seconds and gain {c_number}[SF_37]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}, increased by {c_number}[{SF_42}]{/c} per {c_number}{SF_45}{/c} Skill Ranks.
Damaging enemies with {c_important}Dash{/c} increases their chance to be Critically Struck by {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|%+|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:SIDE_1_CRIT_CHANCE}{/c} seconds.
Enemies you {c_important}Dash{/c} through become {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_41}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Dash{/c} has {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} seconds.
At the end of {c_important}Dash{/c}, gain {c_number}{SF_43}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
